title: Add JSON output for intents resume
summary: Add stable machine-readable output for `covenant intents resume --json` so agents and automation can re-dispatch budget-rejected intents without parsing human text.
expectedFailureModes: Automation scrapes `stderr` for budget errors and breaks when wording changes.
`--json` omits which intent id was resolved when using `latest`, making it hard to correlate resume attempts with audit evidence.
CLI resume regression slips through because the live subprocess test only asserts human-readable text.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant --locked intents_resume_json
cd agent-os && cargo build -p covenant -p research-agent --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_intents_resume --locked -- --ignored live_
nextAction: Add `intents resume --json`, emit one stable JSON object on success and error, extend the existing live resume test to assert the JSON error path, and update CLI usage docs.
